title: v4.1.3 OpenClaw Gateway acceptance
script: $root='C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge'; & openclaw gateway install 1> (Join-Path $root 'gateway-install-v413.txt') 2> (Join-Path $root 'gateway-install-v413.stderr.txt'); if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){$s=& openclaw gateway status --json 2>$null | Out-String; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'GATEWAY_INSTALL_FAILED'}}; & openclaw gateway restart 1> (Join-Path $root 'gateway-restart-v413.txt') 2> (Join-Path $root 'gateway-restart-v413.stderr.txt'); if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'GATEWAY_RESTART_FAILED'}; Start-Sleep -Seconds 4; & openclaw gateway status --json 1> (Join-Path $root 'gateway-after-v413.json') 2> (Join-Path $root 'gateway-after-v413.stderr.txt'); if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'GATEWAY_STATUS_FAILED'}; Write-Output 'V413_054_SCRIPT=PASS'
test: $root='C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge'; $p=Join-Path $root 'gateway-after-v413.json'; if(-not(Test-Path $p)){throw 'GATEWAY_STATUS_ARTIFACT_MISSING'}; $g=Get-Content $p -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $task=Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'OpenClaw Gateway' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $startup=Get-ChildItem ([Environment]::GetFolderPath('Startup')) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {$_.Name -match 'OpenClaw'}; if($null -eq $task -and @($startup).Count -lt 1){throw 'GATEWAY_AUTOSTART_NOT_FOUND'}; Write-Output 'V413_054_TEST=PASS'
rollback: try{& openclaw gateway stop 2>$null|Out-Null}catch{}; try{& openclaw gateway uninstall 2>$null|Out-Null}catch{}; Write-Output 'V413_054_ROLLBACK=PASS'
